headline: Casualties Surge on Six Fronts as Bases Shift
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the fighting has intensified across the most contested sectors. Callums Cape now records roughly 1,610 Colonial and 1,400 Warden casualties per hour, both rates accelerating, with two bases changing hands in the past two hours. Linn Mercy has surged to about 787 Colonial and 1,339 Warden losses per hour, also accelerating, and four bases flipped in the latest two‑hour window. Mooring County remains the deadliest theatre, posting approximately 1,680 Colonial and 1,480 Warden dead per hour, both streams accelerating, and five bases exchanged control. Marban Hollow, which earlier erupted, now shows cooling casualty trends at 120 Colonial and 179 Warden per hour, though enlistments continue to rise. Weathered Expanse maintains heavy attrition at 1,020 Colonial and 1,670 Warden per hour, both accelerating, with six base events in the last two hours. Stlican Shelf reports modest but accelerating Colonial losses at 98 per hour and cooling Warden losses at 148 per hour, with three base changes. Nevish Line has gone quiet, registering only minimal casualties and no recent base turnover. Callahans Passage and other regions show low‑level activity without fresh base moves.
